checks.name: Reassignment invalidates pinned draft, without clearing or converting it
Cancellation while typing blocks a linked answer and preserves intent
Reassign away and back cannot silently restore old draft validity
Read, ordinary message and reminder do not invalidate a valid draft
Stale answered draft cannot become another ordinary reply implicitly
Reassignment audit snapshots question, both recipients, reason, actor and UTC
Wrong actor, removed membership, missing or closed question are conflicts
Only an explicit removal of answer intent yields ordinary-message mode
